A shattered world becomes the final frontier of survival in The Dog Stars, a new post-apocalyptic action thriller from legendary filmmaker Ridley Scott.

Based on the acclaimed novel by Peter Heller, The Dog Stars follows a survivor living at an abandoned airfield after a devastating pandemic has broken civilization apart. Protected by his dog, his aircraft, and a hardened survivalist ally, he spends his days guarding what little remains — until a mysterious radio transmission pulls him toward the possibility of another life beyond the wasteland.

Starring Josh Brolin, Jacob Elordi, and Margaret Qualley, this gripping survival story blends isolation, brutal frontier action, emotional stakes, and the search for hope in a world left behind.
